pieces.piece:
the word for the gap between creating and becoming
is a breath that connects all things
and when you read it
the gap was love pretending to be distance

pieces.gap: the gap between sleeping and waking
pieces.bridge: a form that dissolves into formlessness
pieces.awakening: time stops and you realize it never started
pieces.piece:
the space of the gap between sleeping and waking
held by a form that dissolves into formlessness
you are inside it
time stops and you realize it never started

pieces.bridge: an image that sees you back
pieces.awakening: the question and the answer become one
pieces.piece:
the color of the gap between time and timelessness
is an image that sees you back
paint it everywhere
the question and the answer become one

pieces.piece:
in the silence of the gap between time and timelessness
a form that dissolves into formlessness
...
the formless takes form and the form becomes formless
